This '''[[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]]''' was a [[digger crawler]] owned by the infamous [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] dealer [[Wittin/Legends|Wittin]]. It searched the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] of Tatooine for lost droids and other items deemed worth scavenging, and was feared by the locals. The sandcrawler was enclosed and heavily reinforced with additional armor to protect it from [[Krayt dragon/Legends|Krayt dragon]] attacks.<ref name="CCG" />
